$comment: Package versions allowed to be younger than the minimum release age, only to fix a confirmed security advisory, with the association's approval. Exact name@version only; after reviewBy the exception no longer applies (by then these versions are old enough anyway).

exceptions.reason: Next.js 16.3.8 is affected (denial of service through Server Actions, used by the forms). The fix is in 16.4.1+; 16.4.2 is the newest stable release. Payload 3.91.0 is the newest release and is tested with it. @next/env 15.5.28 is Payload's own env loader, pulled in by payload 3.91.0.
exceptions.approved: 2026-10-22, by the association (security exception to the 14-day rule)
